investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimant Academy (online learning); Platform: on-premises data center DC-South, server range 10.171.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 8gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the quiz-engine PostgreSQL database quiz-db-01; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
